leads.title: Brazilian Supreme Federal Court ruling, March 2018 - legal gender change
leads.documents: Transgender people may change legal gender without surgery, hormonal therapy, judicial document or medical report; by application at registry post
leads.detail: Cited as unanimous STF ruling March 2018; reported 59% increase in gender changes by 2024. No URL visible in text.

leads.title: Amazonas State Law No. 7,552 - 10 June 2025
leads.documents: Bans gender-affirming care for minors under age 18 in Amazonas
leads.detail: Cited as Law No. 7,552 signed by Governor Wilson Lima on 10 June 2025. No URL visible.

leads.title: Manaus municipal law banning unisex restrooms - 18 October 2022
leads.documents: Bans unisex restrooms in Manaus, directly affecting trans/non-binary bathroom access
leads.detail: Cited as signed by mayor of Manaus David Almeida on 18 October 2022. No URL visible.

leads.title: Federal Public Prosecutor's Office (MPF) Recommendation - August 2024
leads.documents: Recommends Amazonas formally enable outpatient and hospital services for transsexualization process including sexual reassignment surgeries, with deadlines for Ministry of Health proposals
leads.detail: Cited as MPF recommendation August 2024 to state of Amazonas. No URL visible.

leads.title: Amazonas Public Defender's Office (DPE-AM) monitoring process - November 2023
leads.documents: Monitors public health services for transgender and travesti people including provision of hormones and surgeries
leads.detail: Cited as DPE-AM process opened November 2023. No URL visible.

leads.title: Amazonas State Law No. 6,463/2023 - gender-neutral language ban in schools
leads.documents: Prohibited gender-neutral language in public and private schools; challenged via ADI by National LGBTI Alliance and Abrafh; suspended by Justice Flavio Dino injunction 29 May, confirmed July 2024, struck down 27 December 2026
leads.detail: Cited as Lei Estadual n. 6.463/2023 proposed by Dep. Debora Menezes (PL), 14-4 vote; STF ADI quotes included. No URL visible.

leads.title: Amazonas State Court of Justice (TJAM) booklet Lar e Direito! / Home is a Right! - August 2024
leads.documents: Guidance for LGBTQ youth expelled from homes; states conversion therapies are prohibited and ineffective
leads.detail: Cited as TJAM booklet released August 2024. No URL visible.

leads.title: DPE-AM Working Group on Sexual Diversity, Gender Identity and Citizenship - 2021
leads.documents: State rights machinery focused on human rights violations and training of security agents
leads.detail: Cited as Grupo de Trabalho Diversidade Sexual, Identidade de Genero e Cidadania established 2021 by Amazonas State Public Defender's Office. No URL visible.

leads.title: Nationwide criminalization of homophobia and transphobia - 2019
leads.documents: Makes homophobia and transphobia equivalent to crime of racism nationwide, including Amazonas; plus Amazonas state policies since 2006 covering sexual orientation and gender identity
leads.detail: Cited as criminalized nationwide since 2019; state protections since 2006. No URL visible.

leads.title: Brazilian Public Security Forum / Brazilian Journal of Public Security data + Fernando Vilaca de Souza homicide 5 July 2025
leads.documents: Documents underreported anti-LGBTQ violence, 43 registered cases; beating/killing of Fernando Vilaca de Souza after reacting to homophobic insults in Manaus, with regret expressed by Ministry of Human Rights and Citizenship, OAB and Dep. Erika Hilton
leads.detail: Cited as Forum/Journal research and 5 July 2025 Manaus incident. No URL visible.
